name: code-field
title: Code Field
description: A one-time-code field: digits pop into cells, a caret glides along, a wrong code shakes and a right one ripples.

perf.budget: One text input and a row of plain views. While focused and empty the caret blinks (one opacity value); otherwise nothing runs.

measurements.notes: The long p99 frame is the system keyboard opening when the field takes focus.

a11y.reducedMotion: Digits appear in place, the caret stays lit, and results change colour without the shake or the ripple.
a11y.screenReader: One text field named by accessibilityLabel, with the number of digits as its hint. Accepted and rejected codes are announced.
a11y.touchTarget: The cells are 56 pt tall and the input covers the whole row.

docs: Prefer `npx kinetik-ui add code-field`: it installs dependencies with expo install, so versions match your Expo SDK.
